decisions.reason: Recently launched with its own page and several rapid releases, this charting plugin fits the firm's web-GIS platform strategy and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
Although it was only briefly mentioned on the website, the hierarchical search plugin is close to the firm's established web-map offering and likely stays as a useful specialist add-on.
Its home-page visibility and clear mobile usability benefit suggest the firm sees this component as an important enhancement for customer-facing map applications.
A GIS solution-building platform is strategically central for an integration-focused geospatial software firm, so taking it off the market within a year would be unlikely.
Mobile field data capture extends the firm's core enterprise geospatial workflows and, with a dedicated page, looks like a meaningful product line rather than a short-lived experiment.
As a search extension for web map apps, it is closely aligned with the firm's established modular product portfolio and likely to be retained unless customer uptake proves clearly weak.
